column1: # The two finals are the random-map size formula: n = minRandomMapSize + randomMapSizeStep * index
# (32 + 8 * n). randomMapVariants (d = 7) is the number of sizes per family and inMemoryRandomMapCount
# (e = 3) the number that fit in memory - the strings past it get the "(mem?)" suffix. skirmishSaves
# and campaignSaves hold WorldSerializer.listSaves("skirmish_"/"campaign_") and their concatenation
# (plus the three random families of d entries) is exactly the map list box.
# The list boxes are named by the action id each reports and by the items they are filled with:
# map (100), nation (101, from the map definition's factions), players (102), teams (103),
# view (104), commando (105), money (106), income (107), time limit (103 again - the original reuses
# the teams id, but the items are TextFormatter.formatTime(...) so the role is not in doubt) and
# difficulty (199, pre-selected to Difficulty.Normal). gameMode (M) is the StartableSessionMode the
# screen both drives and queries for an existing save.
# The panel members mirror CampaignScreen's: winsPanel/winsCaption/winsValue and
# gamesPlayedPanel/gamesPlayedCaption/gamesPlayedValue only exist for a SkirmishGameMode; the
# existing-game branch owns existingGameContainer with its message label, the shared buttonRowPanel
# and the two row highlights under the continue/delete buttons; the options branch owns
# optionsContainer with the shared actionRowPanel plus playRowHighlight/randomizeRowHighlight and the
# two buttons (data 200 = Play, 99 = Randomize, which randomly re-selects every list box).
